summary: Verified new EDR/SIEM webhook feature end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed (auth, presets, CRUD, header masking + mask-preservation on PATCH, /test synthetic push with retry, /push with analyst payload, disabled-webhook 400, delivery history persistence & sorting, template rendering incl. content_mode strip/include). Frontend: Admin 'EDR / SIEM' tab loads AdminWebhooks; all 8 preset buttons visible; create → list → test-push → edit → delete flow works; toast confirmations shown. NivX Forge (/cyberlab) Auto Investigate → AI panel → 'Push to SIEM' button appears when authenticated and AI content present (sigma/yara/iocs), correctly hides when no AI content, dropdown lists enabled webhooks and dispatches push. httpbin.org intermittently returns 503 — delivery record correctly captures status=failed with attempts=3 (retry logic verified).
critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py was missing at /app/backend/ so `from webhooks import delivery` unit tests failed with ModuleNotFoundError under pytest's rootdir. Added /app/backend/conftest.py to inject backend/ into sys.path — 3 previously-failing unit tests now pass.
PushToSIEMButton reads enabled webhooks only via GET /api/webhooks and filters client-side; consider a dedicated /webhooks?enabled=true endpoint if the list grows large.
seed_data_creation: Test webhooks created + cleaned up during automated runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webhook feature is fully functional. If httpbin.org 503s during tests, that's an upstream issue — the tests already accept status in ('ok','failed'). conftest.py at /app/backend/ ensures tests can `import webhooks` regardless of pytest rootdir.
